decisions.reason: As a newly launched multi-model extension of the firm’s established marking portfolio, it reflects visible investment and can easily be defended as still in market-development and integration ramp-up.

This printer is close to the core business, was given standalone website visibility, and fits the firm’s stated push toward broader identification solutions, so management is unlikely to withdraw it after only one year.

Although another recent inkjet launch could make performance comparisons tougher, its close fit with the core offer and the firm’s in-house R&D orientation make continued commitment more likely than an early exit.
